episodes.name: Una vita migliore, Parte 1
episodes.plot: 33 anni dopo lo sbarco sulla terra degli alieni Votan e la guerra che ne è seguita con gli umani, la Terra è un pianeta del tutto stravolto a causa delle potenti armi usate dagli alieni, in grado di dare il via a nuovi processi morfologici...

episodes.name: Defiance Pilot Part 2
episodes.plot: Set in the near future, Defiance introduces an exotically transformed planet Earth, its landscapes permanently altered following the sudden - and tumultuous - arrival of seven unique alien races.

episodes.name: Goodbye Blue Sky
episodes.plot: When the area is hit by a deadly Razor Rain storm, the people of Defiance must run for cover and stay indoors, where they discover truths about themselves and their neighbors.

translations.value: Goodbye Blue Sky

episodes.name: I Just Wasn't Made For These Times
episodes.plot: Gordon McClintock, a NASA hero from the pre-Arkfall days who was presumed dead, is discovered to still be alive when he is revived from an induced sleep; his struggles to adjust in the new world rattle the town.

translations.value: I Just Wasn't Made For These Times

Gordon McClintock, a NASA hero from the pre-Arkfall days who was presumed dead, is discovered to still be alive when he is revived from an induced sleep; his struggles to adjust in the new world rattle the town.

episodes.name: If I Ever Leave This World Alive
episodes.plot: A deadly plague ravages the town; racial tensions escalate when the Irathients, who are immune to the virus, are quarantined.

translations.value: If I Ever Leave This World Alive

episodes.name: The Bride Wore Black
episodes.plot: The town of Defiance is shocked when the remains of a prominent businessman who disappeared almost six years ago, is discovered hidden in the walls of the NeedWant. Lawkeeper Nolan and his deputy Tommy spearhead an investigation that unearths the secrets of many citizens of Defiance, causing unrest on the eve of Alak and Christie's wedding.

translations.value: The Bride Wore Black

The town of Defiance is shocked when the remains of a prominent businessman who disappeared almost six years ago, is discovered hidden in the walls of the NeedWant. Lawkeeper Nolan and his deputy Tommy spearhead an investigation that unearths the secrets of many citizens of Defiance, causing unrest on the eve of Alak and Christie's wedding.

episodes.name: Past Is Prologue
episodes.plot: Amanda's mayoral campaign is jeopardized when Nolan is involved in an accident just before the election, causing the town to question Amanda's decision to appoint him as Lawkeeper.

translations.value: Past Is Prologue
Amanda's mayoral campaign is jeopardized when Nolan is involved in an accident just before the election, causing the town to question Amanda's decision to appoint him as Lawkeeper.

episodes.name: Everything Is Broken
episodes.plot: The citizens of Defiance prepare to cast their votes for mayor, while Nolan is violently confronted with his past and Irisa must decide whether or not to embrace her destiny.

translations.value: Everything Is Broken
The citizens of Defiance prepare to cast their votes for mayor, while Nolan is violently confronted with his past and Irisa must decide whether or not to embrace her destiny.

seasons.name: Stagione 2
seasons.plot: As the story of "Defiance" resumes, the lives of the townspeople are in drastic turmoil. The Earth Republic has assumed control of the town, with far-reaching consequences including a new mayor. Nolan traverses the badlands to find a lost Irisa, Amanda has an unexpected new role in the town as she searches for Kenya and the Tarr family desperately tries to keep control of their criminal empire ...

translations.value: Stagione 2

As the story of "Defiance" resumes, the lives of the townspeople are in drastic turmoil. The Earth Republic has assumed control of the town, with far-reaching consequences including a new mayor. Nolan traverses the badlands to find a lost Irisa, Amanda has an unexpected new role in the town as she searches for Kenya and the Tarr family desperately tries to keep control of their criminal empire ...

episodes.name: The Opposite of Hallelujah
episodes.plot: Season 2 opens in "New Chicago" as Nolan's desperate search for Irisa finally yields vital information taking him south to "Angel Arc" Los Angeles.

translations.value: The Opposite of Hallelujah
Season 2 opens in "New Chicago" as Nolan's desperate search for Irisa finally yields vital information taking him south to "Angel Arc" Los Angeles.

episodes.name: In My Secret Life
episodes.plot: Irisa is arrested after returning to Defiance but Mayor Pottinger offers Nolan her release in exchange for capturing those responsible for unleashing a deadly explosion which nearly killed him. Meanwhile, Stahma plots to keep Datak behind bars in order to continue controlling the family's criminal enterprise.

translations.value: In My Secret Life

Irisa is arrested after returning to Defiance but Mayor Pottinger offers Nolan her release in exchange for capturing those responsible for unleashing a deadly explosion which nearly killed him. Meanwhile, Stahma plots to keep Datak behind bars in order to continue controlling the family's criminal enterprise.

episodes.name: The Cord And The Ax
episodes.plot: Irisa's terrifying black-outs escalate, driving a wedge of secrecy between her and a worried Nolan. Meanwhile, the Tarr family business thrives under Stahma's self-appointed direction while an increasingly suspicious Datak remains in jail.

translations.value: The Cord And The Ax

Irisa's terrifying black-outs escalate, driving a wedge of secrecy between her and a worried Nolan. Meanwhile, the Tarr family business thrives under Stahma's self-appointed direction while an increasingly suspicious Datak remains in jail.

episodes.name: Beasts of Burden
episodes.plot: After his caravan is viscously attacked in the badlands, a badly shaken Pottinger orders Nolan to hunt down and destroy those responsible. Nolan's manhunt implicates one of Rafe's miners causing tensions to explode.

translations.value: Beasts of Burden

episodes.name: Put the Damage On
episodes.plot: Amanda is terrorized by a stalker but the true reasons behind her frightening experiences have far reaching ramifications not only for her but for Pottinger and Doc Yewll as well.

translations.value: Put the Damage On
Amanda is terrorized by a stalker but the true reasons behind her frightening experiences have far reaching ramifications not only for her but for Pottinger and Doc Yewll as well.

episodes.plot: After an Arkfall crash, Pottinger recruits Nolan to lead their salvage mission but his secret agenda puts them in grave danger against an alien race they've never encountered before.

episodes.plot: Nolan interrogates a suspected Votanis Collective spy in order to prevent a catastrophic terrorist attack on New York.

episodes.name: All Things Must Pass
episodes.plot: Nolan races to save Tommy's life and stop Irisa before her growing forces can put their devastating plan into motion. Meanwhile back in town, escalating tensions between Amanda and Stahma lead to a daring showdown between the two.

seasons.plot: A seguito degli accadimenti rimasti in sospeso nel finale della seconda stagione, la terza stagione si apre alla vigilia di un imminente assedio della città, caduta in disgrazia dopo il crollo delle sue redditizie miniere.

episodes.name: Il Mondo Di Cui Ci Impadroniamo / Gli Ultimi Unicorni

overview.value:
2047: il volto della Terra è completamente trasformato e le regole di una volta sono ormai carta straccia. Dopo più di trent'anni dall'arrivo di diverse razze aliene sulla Terra, il paesaggio è completamente sfigurato e reso quasi irriconoscibile dalla terraformazione degli invasori. Defiance, eretta su quello che è rimasto della città di St. Louis, è un baluardo di pace ed equilibrio ed è proprio qui che si snodano le vicende dei protagonisti della serie.

.

la Serie Tv è stata cancellata (16 ottobre 2015), quindi non esiste una conclusione della terza stagione.

In the near future, planet Earth is permanently altered following the sudden—and tumultuous—arrival of seven unique alien races. In the boom-town of Defiance, the newly-formed civilization of humans and aliens must learn to co-exist peacefully.

overview.value: Nel 2046, più di trent’anni dopo l’arrivo sulla Terra di diverse razze aliene, il paesaggio è profondamente cambiato, così come il modo di vivere degli umani. L’arrivo a Defiance, città di frontiera nota un tempo come St. Louis, del misterioso avventuriero Nolan - un ex militare che ha partecipato al conflitto alieno - e del suo braccio destro Irisa, è visto come una speranza dal sindaco Amanda Rosewater, che spera di respingere con il loro aiuto i pericoli che ogni giorno minacciano la pace e la sopravvivenza nella sua comunità.
